bng.title: Bengali pages
bng.sub: A Bengali page is listed by search engines, named in the sitemap and linked as the Bengali twin only once it is marked ready here: its main content translated and checked.
bng.bengaliOff: The Bengali shop is switched off (Settings › Language), so no Bengali page is shown or listed now. You can still prepare the pages here.

kpi.waitingFoot: Bengali text there, not marked ready

bng.readyMissing: Marked ready, but its Bengali text has since been removed
bng.markAll: Mark all {n} on this page ready
bng.noManage: Marking pages needs the SEO permission.
bng.leftOver: {n} pages marked ready earlier are not on the shop any more (removed products or collections). They are kept and do nothing.

err.NO_BENGALI: This page has no Bengali text yet. Write its Bengali name and description first.
err.NOT_FOUND: This page is not on the shop any more.
err.STALE: Someone else changed the list just now; it shows their change now.
err.INVALID_INPUT: That did not work. Please try again.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended — please sign in again.
err.other: That did not save. Please try again.

card.h: Bengali pages that are not ready yet
card.d: What a visitor sees on a Bengali page that is not marked ready. Either way it stays out of search engines and the sitemap.
card.notReady: On a Bengali page that is not ready
card.unlisted: Show it in Bengali, kept out of search engines
card.english: Send the visitor to the English page for now
card.notReadyHelp: The bag, checkout, account and search pages are never sent anywhere.
card.readOnly: You can see this choice; changing it needs the SEO permission.
